items.html:
Yes—as a separate experiment for demonstrably difficult, locally coupled clusters. It is not yet justified as the default next optimization.

Construct a disjoint partition into small spatial groups, initially 2–8 spheres. For each group (g), factor the exact principal block [ P_g=A_{gg},\qquad A=I-TC. ] Its diagonal particle blocks are identity and off-diagonal blocks are (-T_iC_{ij}). Consequently, one-particle block Jacobi does nothing. The current operator and absence of self-coupling are explicit at iterative.rs:141 and iterative.rs:168.

Use the existing batched GMRES closure:

  • Forward: solve (AP^{-1}z=b), return (x=P^{-1}z).
  • Adjoint: solve (A^HP^{-H}w=g), return (y=P^{-H}w). This operator is not ((AP^{-1})^H=P^{-H}A^H).
  • Preserve convergence against the original physical residual and original RHS norm. Current GMRES explicitly recomputes its supplied operator’s residual at gmres.rs:146.
  • Reuse the same factors for both solves; existing Lu already supports equilibrated forward and adjoint solves at linalg/mod.rs:293. No derivative of the preconditioner or partition is required for the existing implicit pullback of the original equation.

For (N) particles, (m=2L(L+2)) modes each and fixed group size (q), approximate additional costs are:

Operation Cost
Assemble local interactions (O(Nq)) pair blocks
Factor groups (O(Nq^2m^3))
Retain factors (O(Nqm^2))
Apply preconditioner (O(Nqm^2)) per RHS

Translation assembly has its own order-dependent cost. High (L) can make even small-group setup expensive; report setup plus forward plus pullback time, memory and amortization across illuminations.

Material limitations:

  • Disjoint groups miss strong interactions across group boundaries. A compact contact network may need overlapping methods eventually, but that should follow evidence.
  • Spatial proximity does not guarantee coupling strength; surface gaps matter for unequal radii, and material resonances matter too.
  • Local groups cannot reliably cure collective modes spanning the whole cluster. Continued iteration growth with (N) suggests a global/coarse correction; unchanged (N^2) operator cost remains a separate scaling limit.
  • A principal block can be singular or ill-conditioned while the full system is solvable. Use existing pivoted/equilibrated LU and report unsupported failures in the experiment; do not silently add shifts, adaptive repartitioning or pseudoinverses.
  • Existing “strongly coupled” validation deliberately uses restart: 3 (iterative.rs:694). Multiple restarts there do not establish a performance problem at the default restart length of 30.

The useful acceptance criterion is a reduction in total current-batched solver time at unchanged accuracy, across both locally clustered and globally coupled geometries, including independent forward and adjoint behavior. Iteration counts alone are insufficient. Read-only assessment; no edits, builds or timings.
